Mark it down, familia — Queersgiving is coming home to Azucar! 🧡🍂 A whole table set for chosen family, full plates, fuller hearts, and zero reason to spend the holidays alone. Grab your favorite dish, bring your people, and let's build a Thanksgiving spread that actually feels like home. No pressure, no perfect dish required — just show up hungry and ready to give thanks together. This is the one you circle on the calendar now so you don't miss it later. 📅

Picture it: the smell of tamales and pumpkin pie drifting through Azucar, plates clinking, laughter bouncing off the walls, and your chosen family gathered 'round. 🍽️🧡 That's Queersgiving. It's warm sweet potato mash, somebody's secret family recipe, the clink of cups raised in gratitude. It's that cozy, full-belly, full-heart feeling you chase every November. No stress, no perfect table setting — just good food, good people, and good vibes filling every corner. Come taste the season the way it's supposed to feel. 🍂✨

No matter your table growing up, there's a seat for you at this one. 🧡 Queersgiving at Azucar is about chosen family — the friends who became your home, the people who pass the plate and ask for seconds without judgment. Come as you are, bring a dish if you've got one, or just bring your appetite and your story. All ages, all walks, one big table of gratitude. This season is about who shows up for you, and we're showing up for each other. 🍽️🌈

It's free, it's all ages, and all you need to bring is a dish to share (or just yourself — seriously, come hungry). Think sides, desserts, your abuela's recipe, whatever makes your table feel like home. One afternoon, one big table, one community giving thanks together. Don't let this one slip past you. 🧡🍂
